selection: highest validation macro initial AUROC; exact ties choose smaller lambda
z: per-scene mean/std from ALL validation frames only; std zero ->1
initial: native DINO per-frame z + lambda * expanded T1 PROB z
downstream: mean hybrid score in each stride16 block, then frozen retrieval/smoothing/position; initial remains native frame formula
position_default: OFF; full final position ON ablation also reported
T1_model: reuse Stage8 Step1 frozen model and prompt
